about: Mean of M over all candidates and inside open windows lo < M < hi (MeV/c^2). meanErr is sd/sqrt(n), which ignores that the background shifts the mean.

centredOnFit.about: The same means in windows centred on the fitted 1864.47 (d0-fit.json mu, rounded as the deck draws it), half-widths 25 / 15 / 10 / 5 MeV/c^2. nClosed and meanClosed use lo <= M <= hi, as dk-hist's {window} does.

source.note: Read through the course's D0_KPi.csv (sha256 25c3c97299ea844f27308fde20a00ecaa87580868f3c767d7ade5621c1505136, 3 926 142 B), the four filled branches D0_MM, D0_PT, D0_TAU, D0_MINIPCHI2 of DecayTree, 91 583 entries; checked equal to the ROOT file value for value on 2026-10-29. Rows are D0 candidates: the portal's 53 948 counts events. runNumber, eventNumber and GpsTime are zero in the file, so the data-taking year cannot be read from it.
